entries.en: column; pillar
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头“Cbico ch fanco”残讹不可解，汉字、闽南语、官话三栏皆空，材料不足无从定释义。

entries.en: to set out wine; to prepare a feast
entries.notes: 汉字栏第二字有[疑:設/沒]，取“設酒”义；且闽南语 pierchiù 与官话 jit chǐn 两栏音写不一致。

entries.en: to invite; to invite someone to do something
to divide; to distribute; to share out
entries.notes: 闽南语声调栏污损难辨（T99）；据汉字“分”与西语 repartiendo（分与）定分派义。

entries.en: to lodge; to put up; to receive (a guest) into one's house
entries.notes: 汉字栏作“晋”，与西语 hospedar（留宿）不合；音写 Lau 指向“留”，疑汉字为形误，按留宿义定。

entries.en: to invite; to request; to entreat
to lead; to summon and gather many people
entries.notes: 闽南语声调栏污损难辨（T99），且西语“邀众人”与汉字“率（率领）”语义略有出入。

entries.zh: 宣请；礼请（以礼正式相邀）
entries.en: to invite with courtesy; formally to invite

entries.zh: 宣召；宣召臣民（下召召集）
entries.en: to proclaim; to summon one's subjects
entries.notes: 西语释义中段残缺（[残]），据汉字“宣”与官话对音 siěn 定宣召臣民之义。

entries.zh: 招；招呼；招引（招手唤人，兼有招惹义）
entries.en: to beckon; to summon; to invite
invited guest
entries.notes: 两栏声调均污损难辨（T99）；释义据西语 convidado 与汉字“客”互证，核心义仍清晰。

entries.en: guest
to lay out a feast; to prepare a banquet
to invite someone; to invite people

entries.zh: 请酒；邀人赴宴（请吃酒席）
entries.en: to invite to a feast; to invite someone to drink
entries.notes: 汉字栏“食請酒”三字与两栏音写（各两音节）不对应，取“請酒”，按西语 convidar al combite（邀赴宴席）定。

entries.en: to invite (a passer-by) in; to bid welcome
entries.notes: 汉字栏第二字有[疑:盡/進]，据西语“邀过路之人（入内）”取“請進”。

entries.zh: 做主人；做东（当宴客之主）
entries.en: to act as host; to give the feast

entries.zh: 邀游；相邀出游（邀人同游）
entries.en: to invite on an excursion; to invite out for an outing

entries.zh: 留不住；邀宿而客不肯留
entries.en: to invite to lodge but (the guest) is unwilling
entries.notes: 汉字栏“晋不帶”义晦（“晋”疑为“留”之形误），释义主要据西语“邀其留宿而不肯”定。

entries.zh: 让天下；让位于人（禅让天下）
entries.en: to yield the empire; to cede the realm to another
entries.notes: 西语词头“desprincipes, desiguales”讹乱难解，释义据汉字“讓天下”与官话对音 yāng tiěn hiā 定。

entries.zh: 让位；让出位子（让位与人）
entries.en: to give up one's position; to yield the throne
entries.notes: 西语词头“de fuere”残讹难解，释义据汉字“讓位”与官话对音 yāng vȳ 定。

entries.zh: 谢酒；谢宴（酒宴之后向主人致谢）
entries.en: to return thanks for the wine; to thank one's host after the feast

entries.zh: 筵席；酒席（菜肴丰盛之宴席）
entries.en: banquet; feast; a table spread with much food
